resources.string: Keeps Diablo II alive in the background so Android does not end the game.
For the app\'s texts. The game keeps its own language.

Small (720 lines, more of the world)
Fewer frames per second save battery and keep the phone cooler. Works from the next game start.
The title music before the game and the click on every tap. Same as the \"Music\" button at the top of every page.

Works from the next game start. Before that the app backs up your saves to Download/%1$s.
Tap: 1 point, double tap: 5 points, long press: all free points
Share packs all characters and stashes into one zip file. Load brings them back: characters with the same name are replaced, all others stay, and your current saves are backed up first.
So that Android does not close the game in the background: %1$s.
The game is still running: please choose "Save and Exit" in the game, then choose the folder.

So that Android does not end the game while you use another app. The app saves before every pause – if the game is ended anyway, you only lose your position.
Allowed. It takes you back to the game or saves and quits it.
Off. The protection still runs, but "Continue" and "Save and quit" in the notification are missing.
Done. Android does not restrict the app in the background.
Android may restrict the app in the background and end it sooner.
Off. Android does not limit the game processes. Stays only while the developer options are on.
Active. On this Android version it can only be switched off from a PC (ADB).

Active: Android may end game processes when all apps together have more than 32 child processes (the game needs about 10). To switch it off, first enable the developer options: under "About phone" tap "Build number" 7 times, then come back here.

Active: Android may end game processes when all apps together have more than 32 child processes (the game needs about 10). In the developer options, section "Apps", enable "Disable child process restrictions".
The app cannot check this. In the app overview tap ⋮ above the Diablo II card → "Lock app". Then "Close all apps" no longer ends the game.

\"Grid\" view (instead of run button and stamina)
On: the bar shows four values you pick below. Off: run button and stamina like the game.
Box with clock instead of the mini panel
The arrow above the belt folds a box with clock and values open and shut, instead of the game\'s small panel.

Level at the left of the experience bar

Hide the mouse pointer while walking and fighting

Only monsters in front of the character

Without the joystick, aim help skips monsters within this angle behind the character: turn towards them yourself. Off: all around as before.
Highlight the target like the mouse does
Shows the target\'s name and life bar. Off: a box at the top left with name and life.

More players: tougher monsters, more experience and loot. Single player only.
A tome holds 80 scrolls instead of 20, a key stack 50 instead of 12. Single player only.
A button at the stash opens an extra store for runes, gems and skulls, shared by all characters (hardcore has its own). Single player only. Off only hides the button.
The map shows the whole act with exits and waypoints.

When you hold \"Take\", a ring in the middle shows the targets. Push your thumb towards a target and let go. With more than 8, turn the page left and right.

Play with a controller via Bluetooth or USB, set up like Diablo II Resurrected.

Tap a box to give a button a job. You put a skill on F1–F8 in edit mode: press the pad button, point at the skill with the stick, press A. Holding \"Take\" opens the ring of targets: the stick chooses, A takes, the cross left/right turns the page.

Always the same: left stick walks, holding LT gives the second row, the cross drinks from the belt, Start opens the game menu (hold: app menu), View as assigned below, the inventory by default (hold: a wheel of the game\'s windows, a stick chooses, let go opens). In windows the stick moves the pointer, A clicks, B/X click right (in a shop: buy, on your own items sell), Y closes; holding R3 in the inventory sorts it.
How far the stick has to move
How fast the stick moves the mouse pointer in inventory, stash and shop.
Turn it up if the character walks by itself.
What the left (L) and right (R) shoulder keys do. \"Skill\" is the one on F7/F8, you pick it in edit mode.

The installation of Diablo II is not finished yet. Tap \"Continue installing\". It goes on in the same folder.
The game is still running. It has to be closed to install. The app saves your character, closes the game and then opens the installation.
The save is not confirmed, the game is still running. \"Quit anyway and install\" closes it now (what happened since the last save may be missing). \"Keep playing\" leaves it running.

The game is still running. It has to be closed to install. The app cannot save it right now: what you played since the last save will be lost. Safer: choose \"Save and Exit\" in the game, then install here.
The installation of Diablo II is not finished yet. There are saved games in its folder, so it goes on in a new folder. Your saved games stay in the old folder. Tap \"Continue installing\".
Puts a shortcut with the Diablo II icon from your game folder on the home screen, as on the PC. The app\'s own icon stays.
The home screen asks whether to add it.
No icon found: choose the game folder with Game.exe first.
This home screen does not take shortcuts from apps.
The app may not use \"Download\". Without this access it cannot store the game. Tap \"Allow access\".
Not enough room: %1$s GB free, %2$s GB needed. Delete photos, videos or old downloads, then tap \"Try again\". What is downloaded stays.
Blizzard cannot be reached. Check Wi-Fi and flight mode. A Wi-Fi with a login page (hotel, train) needs you to log in first in the browser. Then tap \"Try again\". (%1$s)
Blizzard refused the download (%1$s). Try again later. Nothing was installed.
The download of %1$s did not finish, for example because the network went away. \"Try again\" goes on where it stood. (%2$s)
The downloaded files of %1$s are damaged (%2$s). They were deleted. \"Try again\" loads them anew.

Blizzard\'s programs could not start (%1$s). Tap \"Try again\". If it happens again: close the app completely and open it again; the installation goes on where it stood. If that does not help: restart the phone.
Installing %1$s did not finish (%2$s). The keys were dropped for safety. Check them and enter them again.
The game is installed, but the patch to 1.13d did not work (%1$s). Check the Wi-Fi, then \"Try again\": it repeats only the patch. You do not need the keys any more.
The installation is not a complete 1.13d (%1$s). The installed folder stays for now. \"Start anew\" removes it after a question; the downloaded files stay, you will need the keys again.
Diablo II and Lord of Destruction are installed. Only the patch to 1.13d is missing. You do not need the keys any more.
Start anew? The unfinished installation and the downloaded files are removed. You will need the keys again.
Start anew? The downloaded files are removed. The folder with your saved games stays as it is. You will need the keys again.
Start anew? This installation folder is removed. The downloaded files stay; you will need the keys again.
The language of the interrupted setup. For another one: \"Start anew\".
Diablo II 1.13d is installed in %1$s but not chosen yet.
A setup was interrupted. \"Next\" goes on where it stood. You enter the keys again.
A setup was interrupted. There are saved games in its folder, so \"Next\" goes on in a new folder (%1$s). Your saved games stay in the old folder. You enter the keys again.
No progress for %1$d minutes. Is the network there, is the storage not full? The download goes on by itself once it can. Else \"Cancel\" and \"Next\" later.
Keep the app open and the phone charging. Blizzard\'s programs run unseen in the background.

The app downloads Diablo II and Lord of Destruction with Blizzard\'s official downloader, installs them with your own CD keys and updates the game to 1.13d. Everything lands in Download/D2Android. Use Wi-Fi: about 2 GB are downloaded.
%1$s GB free – enough (at least %2$s GB needed).
Only %1$s GB free – at least %2$s GB are needed. Free some space and come back.
Both downloads finished. Keys and installation follow in the next build.
Diablo II 1.13d is installed in Download/%1$s.
The game will start from Download/%1$s from now on. Your previous game folder stays untouched.
The game is still running: please choose "Save and Exit" in the game, then install.
Blizzard\'s installer did not accept a key. Please check both keys.
Blizzard\'s installer did not start with the %1$s key. Usually a key is mistyped. Please check both keys.
The installer has not installed anything after 3 minutes. If a key is mistyped: check the keys. Otherwise please keep waiting.
The installer shows its start menu and has not installed anything yet. If a key is mistyped: check the keys. Otherwise please keep waiting.
The installer has started after all. It goes on.

Diablo II and Lord of Destruction each need their own key (16 or 26 characters, from the box or your Battle.net account). The keys stay only in memory and go straight to Blizzard\'s installer; the app does not store them.
Please check the keys. Diablo II: %1$s. Lord of Destruction: %2$s.

On the left the menu: settings, build, tour, keyboard, quit. Next to it assign keys, walk, names, the game\'s windows and pause. The arrow folds the bar.

• Fire Bolt hits from afar, early and cheaply.\n• From level 12 Fire Ball hits whole groups.\n• With Meteor and Fire Mastery the build stays strong into Nightmare.
• Fire immune monsters (common in Hell) are hard to kill.\n• Little life, so keep your distance.\n• Needs mana potions.
• Frozen Armor gives defense early.\n• Warmth refills mana faster.\n• Gear with faster cast rate (FCR) and mana pays off.

• Cold slows almost everything.
• Ice Blast hits hard from level 6.
• From 24 Blizzard covers a whole area.
• Safer than fire, because monsters arrive slower.
• Cold immune monsters.\n• Blizzard hits moving targets less well.\n• Single targets only until level 24.
• Frost Nova frees you when monsters come too close.\n• Glacial Spike and Ice Bolt strengthen Blizzard.

• Lots of life, melee without mana trouble.
• Double Swing hits twice early on.
• From 24 Frenzy makes him fast in attack and run.
• Battle Orders gives a lot of life and mana.
• Stands among the monsters, needs healing potions.\n• Needs two good weapons.\n• Slow against ranged attackers.
• Renew Shout and Battle Orders before a fight (the app does it).\n• Sword Mastery fits swords. Another weapon type would be a build of its own.
• Teeth hits several monsters early.\n• From level 18 Bone Spear pierces whole rows.\n• Bone damage (magic) has hardly any immunities.
• Little life, so keep your distance.\n• Lots of mana.\n• Without minions he stands alone.
• Bone Armor absorbs hits.\n• Amplify Damage increases damage.\n• Clay Golem holds monsters up.
• Spins through whole groups and hits everything on the way.\n• Sword Mastery makes him strong early, long before Whirlwind.\n• Battle Orders and Battle Command give life, mana and skills.
• Whirlwind only from level 30; until then Concentrate.\n• Every spin costs mana.\n• Needs a fast weapon with high damage.

• Spin through the monsters, not just up to them.\n• One point in Berserk helps against physical immune monsters (magic damage).\n• Leap gets you out of trouble; Natural Resistance helps in Nightmare and Hell.
• Berserk deals magic damage, which hardly any monster resists.\n• Howl and Shout raise its damage.\n• Good against physical immune monsters in Hell.
• Defense drops to zero while attacking.\n• Berserk only from level 30; until then Concentrate.\n• Every blow costs mana.
• Keep Shout and Battle Orders up (the app does it).\n• Drink healing potions early, he gets hit a lot.\n• A weapon with life steal helps.
• Jumps to the target and strikes from above, no walking needed.\n• Leap raises its damage and helps to escape.\n• Strong single hits against bosses.
• Slow against large groups.\n• Idle cannot play it yet and only attacks normally.\n• Needs a sword with high damage.
• Jump from group to group, the monsters stay scattered.\n• Battle Orders gives more life.
• Double Throw hits from afar with two weapons at once.\n• Throwing Mastery raises damage and critical hits.\n• Safe distance from the monsters.
• Throwing weapons run out; Idle buys none yet.\n• Needs two good throwing weapons.\n• Weak against many monsters at once.
• Put a melee weapon on the second weapon slot.\n• Refill throwing weapons at a smith in town.
• War Cry hurts and stuns all monsters around him.\n• Howl, Taunt and Battle Cry raise its damage.\n• Battle Orders and Battle Command help the whole party.
• Needs a lot of mana, and the app puts no points into energy.\n• Only from level 30; until then Double Swing.\n• Little damage against single bosses.
• Stand among the monsters, War Cry hits all around.\n• Drink mana potions; items with mana help.
• Charged Strike hits one target with many bolts at once.\n• From level 30 Lightning Fury hits whole groups from afar.\n• Power Strike, Lightning Bolt and Lightning Strike raise the lightning damage.
• Lightning immune monsters (common in Hell).\n• Lightning Fury uses up javelins; Idle buys none yet.\n• Every throw costs mana.
• Jab and Power Strike carry her up to level 18.\n• Valkyrie and Decoy hold monsters off.\n• Replenish javelins at a smith in town.
• Multiple Shot hits whole groups early on.\n• From level 24 Strafe shoots at many monsters around her.\n• Guided Arrow never misses a single target.
• Arrows run out; Idle buys none yet and then uses Magic Arrow.\n• Needs a good bow and a lot of dexterity.\n• Little life, so keep your distance.
• Magic Arrow needs no arrows.\n• Valkyrie and Decoy draw the monsters away.\n• Pierce lets arrows fly through several monsters.
• Freezing Arrow freezes whole groups solid.\n• Cold Arrow and Ice Arrow raise its damage.\n• Frozen monsters do not hit back.
• Cold immune monsters.\n• Arrows run out; Idle buys none yet.\n• Freezing Arrow only from level 30.
• Ice Arrow is the main attack from level 18.\n• Valkyrie holds monsters off.\n• Magic Arrow helps when the arrows are gone.
• Chain Lightning jumps from monster to monster.\n• Lightning Mastery makes it very strong later on.\n• Static Field takes a part of the life of every monster around.
• Lightning immune monsters.\n• The lightning damage varies a lot.\n• Needs a lot of mana.
• Charged Bolt and Lightning carry her up to level 18.\n• Teleport gets you out of trouble.\n• Frozen Armor gives defense early.
• Frozen Orb sprays ice in all directions and hits whole groups.\n• Ice Bolt raises its damage.\n• Cold slows the monsters.
• Frozen Orb only from level 30; until then Ice Blast.\n• Cold immune monsters.\n• Many points go into Ice Bolt, which is weak on its own.
• Cast Frozen Orb into the middle of a group.\n• Frost Nova frees you when monsters come too close.\n• Teleport keeps the distance.
• An army of skeletons fights for him.\n• Skeleton Mastery makes them stronger.\n• Corpse Explosion clears whole groups.
• Skeletons need corpses to rise.\n• Idle cannot lead minions yet and only fights with Teeth.\n• Weak alone, without his army.
• Raise a skeleton from every corpse.\n• Amplify Damage and Decrepify help the army.\n• Clay Golem slows strong monsters.
• Poison Nova poisons all monsters around him.\n• Poison Dagger and Poison Explosion raise the poison damage.\n• The poison keeps hurting while he moves on.
• Poison immune monsters.\n• Poison takes a while to kill.\n• Idle casts no curses yet, so Lower Resist stays unused.
• Poison Dagger needs a dagger in the hand.\n• Lower Resist makes the poison much stronger.\n• Bone Armor absorbs hits.
• Blessed Hammer spirals around him and hits whole groups.\n• Magic damage: hardly any monster resists it.\n• Concentration, Blessed Aim and Vigor make it very strong.
• Only from level 18; until then melee with Might.\n• Needs a lot of mana, and the app puts no points into energy.\n• Idle does not keep the Concentration aura on yet.
• Put Concentration on the right-hand skill.\n• Holy Shield gives block and defense.\n• Stand in the group, the hammers circle around you.
• Zeal hits several times in a row, fast and accurate.\n• From level 30 Fanaticism raises attack speed and damage.\n• Needs little mana.
• Physical immune monsters in Hell.\n• Needs a good weapon.\n• Idle does not keep the aura on yet.
• Put Fanaticism (before level 30 Might) on the right-hand skill.\n• Sacrifice raises the damage of Zeal.\n• A weapon with life steal helps.
• Vengeance adds fire, cold and lightning to every blow.\n• From level 30 Conviction lowers the resistances of the monsters.\n• Good against monsters with one immunity.
• Many points go into the three resist auras.\n• Every blow costs mana.\n• Idle does not keep the aura on yet.
• Put Conviction on the right-hand skill.\n• Zeal carries him up to level 18.\n• The resist auras also protect him.
• Tornado hits hard, and hardly any monster is immune (physical damage).\n• Hurricane hurts all monsters around him.\n• Cyclone Armor absorbs elemental damage.

• Tornado moves a little at random and misses at times.\n• Only from level 24; until then Arctic Blast and Twister.\n• The game does not report Hurricane and Cyclone Armor yet, so Idle does not renew them.
• Renew Cyclone Armor and Hurricane yourself.\n• Oak Sage gives more life.\n• A Grizzly holds monsters off.
• Fissure burns whole groups from level 12.\n• Volcano and Armageddon add fire and rocks.\n• Firestorm and Molten Boulder raise the fire damage.
• Fire immune monsters.\n• Fissure is slow against fast monsters.\n• The game does not report Armageddon yet, so Idle does not renew it.
• Cast Fissure under the monsters, not in front of them.\n• Keep Armageddon up yourself.\n• A Grizzly holds monsters off.
• As a werewolf he attacks very fast.\n• From level 30 Fury hits up to five times in a row.\n• Lycanthropy gives a lot of life.
• Idle cannot change shape yet and only attacks normally.\n• Physical immune monsters in Hell.\n• Needs a good weapon.
• Change into the werewolf before each fight.\n• Feral Rage gives speed and life steal.\n• A Grizzly holds monsters off.
• Wolves and a Grizzly fight for him.\n• Oak Sage gives the whole pack more life.\n• Safe: the monsters attack the pets.
• Idle cannot lead minions yet and only attacks normally.\n• Slow killing on his own.\n• The pets get stuck in narrow places.
• Summon the wolves again after each death.\n• Carrion Vine and Solar Creeper help with life and mana.\n• Stay behind the pack.
• Lightning Sentry shoots many bolts at the monsters by itself.\n• From level 30 Death Sentry lets corpses explode.\n• Safe: the traps fight, she keeps the distance.
• Lightning immune monsters.\n• At most five traps at the same time.\n• Idle does not know yet that the traps fire by themselves.
• Lay traps near the monsters and step back.\n• Burst of Speed helps a lot.\n• Shadow Master fights alongside her.
• Dragon Talon kicks several times per attack.\n• Needs no charging, so it is simple to play.\n• The damage of the boots counts for the kicks.
• Physical immune monsters in Hell.\n• Melee, so she stands among the monsters.\n• Needs good boots.
• Dragon Flight jumps to a target and kicks.\n• Fade and from level 30 Venom (poison on every kick) help a lot.\n• Shadow Master fights alongside her.
• Phoenix Strike charges up meteors, chain lightning and ice.\n• Three elements: hardly any monster resists them all.\n• Fists of Fire, Claws of Thunder and Blades of Ice raise its damage.
• Charging and finishing take practice.\n• Idle does not know combos yet and only attacks normally.\n• Phoenix Strike only from level 30.
• Charge up to three times, then finish with Dragon Talon.\n• Burst of Speed and Fade help a lot.
• Blade Fury throws blades at a target from afar.\n• Physical damage: hardly any monster is immune.\n• Blade Sentinel and Blade Shield add more blades.
• Single targets only.\n• Needs a lot of mana.\n• Only from level 18; until then Fire Blast.
• Hold the attack, the blades keep flying.\n• From level 30 Venom adds poison to every blade.\n• Burst of Speed and Fade help a lot.
